name: your-harness
description: AI-powered development harness - CLI first, extensible, multi-provider

scripts.build:package-artifacts: npm run build --workspace @your-harness/shared && npm run build --workspace @your-harness/domain && npm run build --workspace @your-harness/application
scripts.prepack: npm run build:package-artifacts && npm run build
scripts.test:core: vitest run tests/cli/create-program.test.ts tests/cli/work-item-command.test.ts tests/cli/persistent-work-item-execution.test.ts tests/core/config.test.ts tests/context-assembler.test.ts tests/engineering-core-smoke.test.ts tests/orchestration/task-orchestrator.test.ts tests/runtime/execute-work-item.test.ts tests/runtime/runtime-environment.test.ts tests/runtime/project-runtime-environment.test.ts tests/runtime/execution-environment.test.ts tests/runtime/execution-eligibility-policy.test.ts tests/sdd/openspec-sdd-provider.test.ts tests/sdd/resolve-execution-source.test.ts tests/trace/execution-trace.test.ts tests/persistence/local-operational-store.test.ts tests/verification/evidence-and-verification-contracts.test.ts tests/verification/completion-authorization.test.ts
scripts.verify:core: npm run build:core && npm run test:core
scripts.verify:pi: npm run build && npm run test:pi
